From the Darkness Comes the Roaring Fire of Victory!
Fuse the powers of the deepest shadow with fiery energy! This GX Challenge Box combines the power of Pokemon-GX with a ready-to-play theme deck and two booster backs. Outfox the competition with Alolan Ninetales GX and expand your collection with this exciting Challenge Box!

Includes:
• 1 foil promo featuring Alolan Ninetales GX
• 1 foil promo featuring Alolan Ninetales
• 2 Pokemon TCG booster packs
• 1 complete Pokemon TCG Theme Deck, ready to play!
• A code card for the Pokemon Trading Card Game Online

The Pokemon TCG: Alolan Raichu Figure Collection Includes:

• 1 never-before-seen foil promo card featuring Alolan Raichu! • 1 Alolan Raichu Pokémon figure • 4 Pokémon TCG booster packs • A code card for the Pokémon Trading Card Game Online
Each 3 Pack blister comes with 3 Burning Shadows Booster packs, 1 coin, and a cosmos holofoil of Alolan Meowth.
Each 3 Pack blister comes with 3 Burning Shadows Booster packs, 1 coin, and a cosmos holofoil of Cosmog.
Each booster display box contains 36 booster packs.

ext_data.CardText:
Nine Tales of Courage!
Alolan Ninetales is keeping it frosty—and its friends are super-hot! Opposites attract when you fuse Fire and Water types, offering two paths to victory. With passionate fire and cool moves, the Luminous Frost deck is all about a winning attitude!

Contents:
• 1 60-card preconstructed deck
• Damage counters
• 1 coin

Each Kommo-o GX Box contains the following:
• 1 holofoil promo of Kommo-o GX and 1 Jumbo version
• 4 Pokemon TCG booster packs
• 1 code card for the Pokemon TCG Online

From the Darkness Comes the Roaring Fire of Victory!
Fuse the powers of the deepest shadow with fiery energy! This GX Challenge Box combines the power of Pokemon-GX with a ready-to-play theme deck and two booster packs. Put a major chomper into play with Lycanroc GX and expand your collection with this exciting Challenge Box!

Includes:
• 1 foil promo featuring Lycanroc GX
• 1 foil promo featuring Lycanroc
• 2 Pokemon TCG booster packs
• 1 complete Pokemon TCG Theme Deck, ready to play!
• A code card for the Pokemon Trading Card Game Online

This Mysterious Powers Tin featuring Ho-Oh contains the following:
• 1 holofoil promo of Ho-Oh GX
• 4 Pokémon TCG booster packs
• A code card to unlock a playable deck in the Pokémon Trading Card Game Online

This Mysterious Powers Tin featuring Marshadow contains the following:
• 1 holofoil promo of Marshadow GX
• 4 Pokémon TCG booster packs
• A code card to unlock a playable deck in the Pokémon Trading Card Game Online

This Mysterious Powers Tin featuring Necrozma contains the following:
• 1 holofoil promo of Necrozma GX
• 4 Pokémon TCG booster packs
• A code card to unlock a playable deck in the Pokémon Trading Card Game Online

Collect the 3 Mysterious Powers Tin featuring Marshadow GX, Necrozma GX, and Ho-Oh GX. Each individual tin contains the following:
• 1 holofoil promo of the respective Pokemon featured on the tin
• 4 Pokémon TCG booster packs
• A code card to unlock a playable deck in the Pokémon Trading Card Game Online

Each Team Skull Pin Collection comes with:
• 4 holofoil promo cards featuring Wimpod, Golisopod GX, Salandit, and Salazzle GX.
• 1 collector's pin featuring the Team Skull logo
• 5 Pokémon TCG booster packs
• A code card for the Pokemon Trading Card Game Online
